quarterly_data.signal: Taiyo Holdings revised up its consolidated forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (previous forecasts disclosed April 30, 2026). First half (April-September 2026): net sales JPY 75,900 million (previously 73,100), operating income JPY 18,900 million (previously 16,800), ordinary income JPY 19,200 million (previously 16,300), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 13,100 million (previously 11,800). Full year: net sales JPY 149,100 million (previously 146,300), operating income JPY 36,400 million (previously 34,300), ordinary income JPY 36,300 million (previously 33,400), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 25,400 million (previously 24,100). Electronics full-year forecast: net sales JPY 105,000 million (previously 102,200), operating income JPY 33,400 million (previously 31,300); Medical and Pharmaceuticals unchanged at net sales JPY 37,500 million and operating income JPY 4,000 million. Stated reason: Electronics outperformed the forecast in the first quarter due to a weaker than expected yen and higher than expected demand for rigid board materials for China; the company replaced its first-quarter Electronics forecast with the actual results, kept its forecasts for the second quarter and beyond unchanged, and reflected special employee benefit expenses recorded as an extraordinary loss in the first quarter.
